expectBefore.description: What the baseline should do with this scenario. fail: feature or bugfix. pass: refactor or regression guard.

redact.description: Extra scrubbing for the stored transcript, on top of the built-in token, secret, password, cookie, and authorization handling.

keys.description: JSON keys and header names whose values are replaced with [redacted], matched as case-insensitive substrings.

patterns.description: Regular expressions; every match in bodies, headers, paths, and logs is replaced with [redacted].

logSettleMs.description: Wait after each response before reading the server log lines that step produced.

reset.description: Run before each side's server starts (for example reseed a dev DB), so before and after start from the same data.

command.description: Must listen on {{PORT}}. PORT is also set in the environment. Its stdout and stderr become the per-step server log.

readyPath.description: Use a health endpoint if there is one.

path.description: Starts with /. Relative to the app root.

headers.description: Synthetic credentials only. Header values whose name looks sensitive are redacted in the transcript.

body.description: Object or array is sent as JSON; a string is sent as-is.

json.description: Dot-path to expected value, for example {"items.0.id": 7}. Compared by JSON equality.

logContains.description: Substring that must appear in the server log lines this step produced.

logAbsent.description: Substring that must NOT appear, for example "ERROR".
